title: Episode 2 (International Women's Day) – 2021 Israeli Election Preview
description:
For International Women's Day we're highlighting some of the candidates running in this month's Israeli election and trying to understand why all, bar one, of the major parties are run by men.

Remember to stay tuned our social media feeds @NIFAustralia for all the latest news from the election.

#Israel #Politics #IsraElex4

NIF is a non-partisan nonprofit organisation. As such, it does not conduct activities to support or oppose any political party, campaign, or candidate for public office. This video is offered solely as an analysis to educate the public on matters of substantive importance.
